IcModal.title: 'Remove instance'
IcModal.p: Remove "" from the host? Both options stop the containers and delete the instance directory, database and filestore included. They differ only in what is left in this panel.

Delete completely also erases every backup stored in , so nothing is left behind that no instance owns. That runs before the containers come down — the only moment anything can still reach the storage — and if it fails the instance is not deleted at all. Keep in panel archives it instead: a fresh full backup is taken now and everything older is pruned, so exactly one restorable copy survives. The instance moves to the project's Archived tab, where it can be brought back on any host and restored from that copy.
This instance has no backup destination, so what is destroyed here cannot be recovered.
